links.outcome: Fabrication and bibliographic accuracy of references generated by ChatGPT-5 for AAOS guideline prompts
links.effect: 350 queries generated 2,736 references; 7.13% fabricated; 49.34% bibliographically accurate; complete accuracy within a query in 8.00% of cases; PMID errors 37.28%.
links.quote: A total of 350 queries generated 2,736 references, of which 7.13% were fabricated.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT citation accuracy and hallucination rates against orthopaedic clinical practice guidelines using standardized prompts, with no specific deployment guardrail tested.
